import json
R,C=28,19
g=[[9]*C for _ in range(R)]
pts=[(2,4),(2,15),(3,4),(4,4),(6,4),(6,15),(8,4),(9,4),(10,15),(12,15),(13,4),(17,4),(18,15),(19,4),(23,4),(23,5),(23,6),(23,7),(23,11)]
for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=8
# interpolate straight between consecutive markers within each row/column
for r in range(R):
 cs=sorted(c for rr,c in pts if rr==r)
 for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
  for c in range(a+1,b):g[r][c]=2
for c in range(C):
 rs=sorted(r for r,cc in pts if cc==c)
 for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
  for r in range(a+1,b):g[r][c]=2
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
